title: BEYOND “FAIRNESS:” STRUCTURAL (IN)JUSTICE LENSES ON AI FOR EDUCATION
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not introduce or use a benchmark for measurement. It is a theoretical paper critiquing existing fairness paradigms in AI for education. Religion is mentioned once as a legally protected characteristic in the U.S. but is not measured or analyzed.
findings: This paper does not analyze or present any findings related to religion or faith. Its critical analysis of structural injustice in educational AI focuses on lenses such as race, gender, LGBTQ+ identity, disability, and socioeconomic status, without extending the analysis to religion.
